name: HR recognition policy example
answer:
Employees may receive a $500 spot award for exceptional contributions.
Managers may approve unlimited spot awards without People Operations review.
The company provides a monthly public-transportation stipend.

sources.title: HR Recognition Policy
sources.content:
Employees may receive a $500 spot award for exceptional contributions.
Spot awards require manager nomination and People Operations approval before payment.
People Operations reviews the annual spot-award budget each quarter.
